claim.claim-text: 1. A hearing aid comprising a hearing aid housing with a connector socket and an earpiece connector with a connector plug, and where the connector socket and the connector plug are configured such that the connector plug is releasably attached in the connector socket for connecting the connector to the hearing aid housing, and wherein the connector plug comprises a connector plug body having a separate deadbolt movably arranged in the connector plug body.
2. A hearing aid according to claim 1, wherein the separate deadbolt is spring activated.
3. A hearing aid according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the connector plug comprises a spring configured for providing a spring force.

4. A hearing aid according to claim 1, 2 or 3, wherein the separate deadbolt comprises a release knob configured such that it allows that a user, by manipulating the release knob, can slide the separate deadbolt in a direction against the force of the spring.

5. A hearing aid according to claim 1, wherein the connector plug has a front end and a oppositely arranged rear end and a free surface extending between the front end and the rear and facing away from the hearing aid housing when the connector plug is attached in the connector socket, and wherein the earpiece connector extends from the rear end of the connector plug.

6. A hearing aid according to claim 1, wherein the separate deadbolt has one or more projections arranged such that it can be moved in the connector plug body between a retracted position where the one or more projections are retracted into the connector plug body and an extended position where the one or more projections extends from the connector plug body and into engagement with the connector socket.

7. A hearing aid according to claim 1 or 5, wherein the connector socket comprises a rear undercut arranged outside the rear end of the connector plug when it is attached in the connector socket, and where the separate deadbolt has one or more projections arranged such that it can be moved in the connector plug body between a retracted position where the one or more projections are retracted into the connector plug body and an extended position where the one or more projections extends from the rear end of the connector plug body and into engagement with the rear undercut in the connector socket.
8. A hearing aid according to claim 6 or 7, wherein the connector plug further comprises a spring element urging the separate deadbolt to be moved to the extended position.

9. A hearing aid according to claim 6, 7 or 8, wherein the distal end of the one or more projections has sloping surfaces arranged such that the one or more projections can snap into and/or out of engagement with the rear undercut.

10. A hearing aid according to anyone of claims 5-9, wherein the connector plug has a front extension projecting outwardly from the front end of the connector plug and where the connector socket has a front undercut arranged such that the front extension engages with the front undercut when the connector plug is attached in the connector socket.

11. A hearing aid according to anyone of the preceding claims, wherein the separate deadbolt is arranged in a slot arranged in the connector plug body at a distance below the free surface and configured so that the separate deadbolt can slide between its extended position away from the front end of the connector plug, and its retracted position closer to the front end of the connector plug.

12. A hearing aid according to anyone or more of the claims 5 - 11, wherein the separate deadbolt comprises a release knob extending through a knob channel in the connector plug body and a distance above the free surface, and where the knob channel is configured such that it allows that a user, by pushing the release knob, can slide the separate deadbolt in a direction against the force of the spring.

13. A hearing aid according to any one or more of the preceding claims, wherein the hearing aid housing is adapted for being carried behind the ear BTE of a hearing aid user, and the connector socket, the connector plug and the earpiece connector is connected to, or configured for being connected to a receiver adapted for being arranged in the ear RIE of the hearing aid user.
